purpose.zh: 倒着撑练肩膀上面，给倒立类动作打底子
purpose.en: Builds the tops of your shoulders in an upside-down hold, prep for handstand-type moves.

text.zh: 手臂伸直，把肩膀往耳朵推，再放下
text.en: Arms straight, push your shoulders up to your ears, then lower

text.zh: 身子成倒 V 字，手肘一直别弯。
text.en: Upside-down V, elbows stay straight the whole time.
Go slow. A small move is enough.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘一弯，成了派克俯卧撑
commonErrors.en: Bending your elbows into a pike push-up.

cautions.zh: 先确认倒 V 撑着不疼；手腕或肩膀不舒服就停
cautions.en: First make sure the upside-down V hold is pain-free. Stop if your wrists or shoulders feel off.

cautions.zh: 先做 1 组轻松的 4–6 次
cautions.en: Start with one easy set of 4–6.

用户已定：改名、计时/计次、每侧/起始侧、计数单位按最终口径处理，相关待定项清除
